hyrox-birmingham|2026-10-27.summary: The first day of the six-day HYROX Birmingham programme at the NEC.

HYROX.label: First Tuesday waves 08:00 GMT · division windows until 20:30
HYROX.note: The current organiser programme explicitly dates Tuesday 27 October 2026 and lists HYROX Men and Adaptive Men from 08:00, followed by Doubles Men 10:40, Doubles Women 13:30, Women and Adaptive Women 15:40, and Doubles Mixed 18:10. These are division wave windows, not one common start.
HYROX.publicNote: Tuesday division wave windows begin at 08:00. Follow the individual start time linked by HYROX.
